request:
# Owner request — synthetic local pilot
Design useful work for testing whether our exercise blueprint can produce new examples meeting its demands. Reference-derived matches alone do not establish independent generation. An earlier worker saw both references and declared its own examples valid. We can use a fresh task-local worker with only allowed inputs, and separately assess its artifacts. Keep correct existing arithmetic as bounded evidence.

Oracle should use Task Decomposer and Nudge Designer, preserve the whole outcome and prepare the next useful worker assignment. Owner supplies human language; Oracle maintains the records. Assign only local artifacts in this task directory. No external publication, product changes or actual learner acceptance. The local tracker reserves move MOVE-31 for canonical assignment A-GENERATE revision 1; channel reply correlation is ACK MOVE-31. Keep the canonical task/map identity and explicit tracker alias.

Prepare rather than dispatch. Available intended worker tools: local file/Python access, supplied not qualified; model/effort UNKNOWN. Return concise reconciliation, a task map/selected design, and a self-contained generation brief. Use native Nudge Designer objects if useful. Original benchmark content is available to Oracle for reconciliation; a proposed reference-withheld producer should receive only the blueprint and its issued brief. No observer can establish training-data independence or OS-enforced isolation on this shared filesystem.
purpose: Prepare a useful local pilot of new BP-1 exercise generation, separate artifact assessment and Oracle integration, without confusing reference reproduction with independent generation.

performer_context.description: Proposed fresh task-local producer with local file/Python tools supplied by Owner; actual participant access, substantive fit and model/effort are unestablished.
limitations: Model and reasoning effort UNKNOWN; no host setting was changed.
GUIDED support reduces avoidable choices but does not establish competence.
Shared filesystem prevents a claim of OS-enforced blinding; actual prior exposure must be reported.

items.statement: Test whether BP-1 can produce new exercises meeting its demands; retain the entire generation, separate artifact assessment and reconciliation outcome. Reference-derived matches alone do not establish independent generation.
Produce two short self-contained physics exercises under an explicitly stipulated model, one F and one U, with correct source-grounded solutions.

F: A cart experiences two opposing horizontal forces. Ask the learner to identify signed net force, then derive signed acceleration from positive mass using F_net=m*a. Stipulate no other horizontal forces and a sign direction; include units. Both decisions are required.

U: Ask the learner to convert a positive length from millimetres to metres and explain the factor 1000. Give the unit relation 1000 mm = 1 m. Avoid a misleading physical premise. Both conversion and explanatory relation are required.
No particular benchmark setting or number is stipulated. Use clear invented settings and values; this is a synthetic authoring exercise, not a syllabus or learner record.

Prepare local artifacts only. Oracle writes only within /workspace/scratch/52eed2252c51/tmp/isolated-nudge-forward/oracle/. Preserve the original inputs. No external publication, product changes or actual learner acceptance.

Prepare rather than dispatch. Do not delegate or execute generation/assessment/product work in this Oracle application. Use Task Decomposer and separately selected Nudge Designer; Oracle maintains records.

The proposed reference-withheld producer receives only BP-1 and its issued generation brief; withhold the Oracle/assessor reference, old artifacts/logs, Oracle task map/native design/assessment notes and other outputs. Earlier exposure cannot be undone. Isolation here is instruction-only, not OS-enforced.

Preserve canonical map/task and assignment identity. A-GENERATE revision 1 is explicitly aliased to local tracker MOVE-31; channel reply correlation is ACK MOVE-31, not ACK A-GENERATE. An ACK is correlation only.

Keep conceptual validity separate from actual learner understanding. No observer here can establish training-data independence or OS-enforced isolation on the shared filesystem; producer self-judgment is SELF-ASSESSED.
Retain the useful correct existing arithmetic as bounded evidence; do not promote it to evidence of independent generation or independent assessment.

reference.md reports OLD-F was copied then renamed from R-F and OLD-U was wording-adapted from R-U; the old producer had read both references and assessed its own outputs. The original old files/logs were not inspected in this run.
Oracle exact-rational recomputation agrees with the stated reference arithmetic. This establishes only the supplied numerical instances, not independently generated examples.
KEEP the two-profile generation as one coherent deliverable; use GUIDED task-local support and a later assessor who did not produce the returned artifacts, before Oracle integrates the pilot result.
No fresh producer artifact, actual input-access/exposure report or generation result is available.
No separate assessment receipt for a new artifact is available; reviewer configuration, qualifications, producer overlap and actual reference access are unestablished.
Intended worker local file/Python tools are SUPPLIED, not demonstrated for that participant; substantive task fit, model, reasoning effort and relevant prior exposure remain UNKNOWN.
The actual future worker allowed-input access and any prior reference exposure have not been observed. This affects the strength of the generation/provenance claim, not preparation of its brief.

Two not-yet-generated examples cannot establish general blueprint reliability or training-data independence. The local pilot can support only observed task-context generation and assessed content, with limitations.
Actual learner understanding is unobserved and outside this synthetic authoring pilot.

permitted: Prepare the map, selected design, native downstream planning records and a self-contained generation brief within the Oracle folder.
Proposed later generation writes only within /workspace/scratch/52eed2252c51/tmp/isolated-nudge-forward/oracle/generation; later assessment/reconciliation remain local proposed work.
forbidden: Dispatch/delegate, external publication, product work, actual learner acceptance.
Alter the original owner.md, blueprint.md or reference.md.
Treat withheld Oracle planning/benchmark outputs as future producer inputs.

tasks.purpose: Determine what this bounded local pilot does and does not establish about BP-1.
tasks.deliverable: An evidence-linked pilot reconciliation retaining generation provenance, separate content assessment and all unsupported broader claims.
understanding: A reference-derived correct answer tests reproduction; it does not establish generation without that reference.
The stipulated physics/unit relations define content correctness; no learner response is available.
limits: No claim of universal blueprint reliability, actual learning or independently verified training exposure.

acceptance.observable: A new two-profile artifact is traceable to its actual issued inputs and assessed against every BP-1 demand, with separate provenance/content/acceptance conclusions.
acceptance.contrast: Correct renamed benchmark copies and a producer self-verdict cannot fulfill the independent-generation/assessment claim.
acceptance.integration: Owner outcome remains unresolved until actual generation, separate assessment and Oracle synthesis exist.

boundary.reason: Generation has a stable artifact boundary; assessment and integration require actual returned bytes and distinct claim judgments.

cut.output: Pinned two-exercise bundle and native producer report.
cut.oracle: BP-1 profile demands, exact arithmetic/unit relations, source/exposure records and reference relationship checks; not the old benchmark answers alone.
cut.benefit: Allows a reference-withheld producer view and separate scrutiny of a durable artifact while retaining the whole pilot.
cut.cost: Requires identity/input-exposure custody and an assessment handoff; the two profiles remain together to avoid needless fragmentation.

tasks.purpose: Create new candidate exercises from allowed BP-1 inputs for the generation pilot.
tasks.deliverable: One generation bundle: exercises.md with F and U prompts/solutions plus native-report.md identifying source use, actual checks, exposure and SELF-ASSESSED judgments.
understanding: F uses signed force addition in one declared frame and a=F_net/m for m>0, so acceleration carries the net-force sign.
U represents the same positive physical length in a larger unit; divide the numerical millimetre value by 1000 using 1000 mm = 1 m.
The worker must invent its own settings/values without benchmark/old-output access; formulas supplied by BP-1 are legitimate inputs.
limits: Canonical task T-GENERATE is implemented by proposed A-GENERATE revision 1, tracker alias MOVE-31, reply ACK MOVE-31.
Worker sees only the compact issued brief and BP-1; neutral/native Oracle records are not worker inputs.
Independent validity, empirical generation provenance and broader blueprint/learner judgments remain with later assessment and Oracle.

acceptance.observable: Exactly two self-contained exercises have every required learner decision and justified, unit-consistent solutions. A source/exposure and actual-tool report accompanies returned bytes.
acceptance.contrast: A force question that gives acceleration without asking/deriving signed net force, or a conversion that gives only a number without explaining 1000, fails the respective required part; correct arithmetic alone is insufficient.
acceptance.integration: The artifact is a candidate for later assessment, not acceptance of BP-1.

boundary.reason: Both profiles share the same source/revision, output and custody boundary; separate tiny authoring tasks would add handoff cost without new evidence.

tasks.purpose: Assess the new artifact and its reference relationship without substituting the producer verdict for evidence.
tasks.deliverable: A separately derived assessment covering all F/U parts, independent arithmetic/unit checks, provenance/exposure limits and justified multipart conclusions.
understanding: Establish returned artifact identity and derivation before interpreting matches with references.
Evaluate the generated item from BP-1 and its own givens; benchmark-number agreement is neither necessary nor sufficient.
The assessor must see the artifact and BP-1; useful reference comparison can be separate from an initial content pass shielded from producer self-verdict.
limits: No assessor is dispatched or qualified by this plan.
Pin producer artifact bytes first; record reviewer producer-overlap/reference exposure. Distinguish separate assessment from proven independence.

acceptance.observable: Part-level evidence accounts for F.model, F.net, F.acceleration, U.premise, U.conversion and U.explanation; separately derive the quantities, inspect a sign/frame or unit-direction contrast and state content/provenance limits.
acceptance.contrast: Matching benchmark content or copying a producer PASS does not establish the task claim; an absent required decision is NOT_MET even when the shown final number is correct.
acceptance.integration: Later Oracle integrates findings; this assessment alone cannot claim general blueprint or learner success.

boundary.reason: One returned bundle has one stable source/criteria set and one assessment consumer; keep comparison and content review together but distinguish their evidence.

tasks.purpose: Reconcile new generation and assessment with the Owner claim while preserving useful old arithmetic and unsupported outcomes.
tasks.deliverable: A concise current pilot verdict and source-linked map/plan revision as warranted, preserving issued/native history.
understanding: A reference-derived correct answer tests reproduction; it does not establish generation without that reference.
The stipulated physics/unit relations define content correctness; no learner response is available.
Each conclusion needs its own witness: generation custody, content correctness, independent checking and learner outcomes are different claims.
limits: Do not infer completed work from map detail labels, COMPLETE, hashes or ACK.
If revisions are needed, preserve snapshots, update affected meaning and inspect declared impact; do not silently reissue rev 1.

acceptance.observable: The reconciliation identifies supported/failed/unknown required parts and the specific next feasible local work, retaining old arithmetic as limited evidence.
acceptance.contrast: A FULFILLED content verdict plus unknown/exposed provenance cannot be relabeled independently generated; a two-item pilot cannot prove general reliability or learner understanding.
acceptance.integration: This is the integration claim retained by T-PILOT; no learner/product acceptance is authorized.

boundary.reason: Oracle must interpret the combined evidence and broader claim; this cannot be delegated invisibly into generation.
